scripts.record: node scripts/record.mjs "$CHROME" http://127.0.0.1:8791/clip.html .frames 24 20 && ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -framerate 20 -i .frames/f%04d.png -vf "scale=1200:-2:flags=lanczos,format=yuv420p" -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -preset slow -movflags +faststart assets/race.mp4 && ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -framerate 20 -i .frames/f%04d.png -vf "fps=12,scale=800:-1:flags=lanczos,split[a][b];[a]palettegen=max_colors=96[p];[b][p]paletteuse=dither=bayer:bayer_scale=4" assets/race.gif && rm -rf .frames
